# Packages

The "Packages" layer of the Excalidraw-monorepo contains various utility and helper functions used throughout the Excalidraw application, including analytics tracking, drawing trails, clipboard operations, and more.

## Overview

This layer is responsible for providing essential functionality that supports the core features of the Excalidraw application. It includes utility functions, event handling, and other helper classes that are used across different parts of the application.

## Responsibilities

- **Analytics Tracking**: Functions to track user interactions and application performance.
- **Drawing Trails**: Logic for creating and managing drawing trails.
- **Clipboard Operations**: Functions for copying and pasting elements.
- **Event Handling**: Utility classes and functions for handling events in the application.
- **Color Manipulation**: Functions for working with colors in the application.
- **Font Metadata**: Data structures and functions for managing font information.

## How it works

The files in this layer work together to provide a suite of utility functions and helper classes that support the core features of the Excalidraw application. For example, the `packages/common/src` folder contains various utility classes and functions used throughout the project, including event buses, binary heaps, bounds calculations, color manipulation, constants, editor interfaces, emitters, font metadata, and more.
